test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Immersive"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Immersive"** is the correctly spelt word.
 
• The word **"Immersive"** means- involving, or characterized by deep absorption or immersion in something.
 
 
• **Example: **His writings are so** immersive** that it can become the best seller in the market very soon.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 2)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us understand the correct spelling and meaning of other options too.

 
• **Experiences: **A state of something that has happened which has an effect on you, or a practical knowledge or skill.

 
 
• **Example: **The Professors of my college are highly **experienced.**
 
 
 
• **Institutionalized:** established as part of an official organization.
 
 
• **Example:** The division of powers in government is **institutionalized** both among the central government and the state government.
 
 
 
• **Tremendous:** Very large or great.
 
 
• **Example: **The athlete has a **tremendous** amount of energy.
